paragraphs: R. Yaakov bar Avina expounded before R. Yitzḥak, Midrash Megillah, at the verse 'On the seventh day.' Bar Avinah, Midrash Ḥazit, at 'I rose to open to my beloved.' Bar Avina, in the name of R. Levi bar Susi, Midrash Kohelet, at 'A generation goes and a generation comes.' R. Menaḥem, R. Elazar bar Avuna's son-in-law, in his name.
